g.text: Examine the action curve, then evaluate it separately
Clinical illustration / empirical support and held-out evaluation of recorded action probability
MIMIC / 126,332 encounters / learning curve held fixed
Probability bins of width 0.1; area reflects bin count
Descriptive bins; no confidence intervals shown
Source windows vary across actions. Predictions use continuous interpolation with endpoint clipping; empty reliability bins are omitted.
Action probability describes recorded practice. It is distinct from outcome risk and from the proportion with action among all alerts.
